action_magnitude: sqrt(mean over five raw actions of sum over five action coordinates of action^2))
derivation: discovery_fit episodes only; frozen before any V4 episode generation

regime_definitions.contact: current five-step contact window positive and not impact
regime_definitions.impact: current five-step contact window positive and preceding window negative
regime_definitions.other_free_motion: no current contact and block displacement > 0.0
regime_definitions.static: no current contact and block displacement <= 0.0

target_motion: Euclidean block-position displacement over the target five-step interval
